name: claude-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods for the terminal and the desktop app

plugins.name: statusline-desktop
plugins.description: Your terminal status line, drawn above the prompt in the Claude desktop app

plugins.name: forgejo-issues
plugins.description: Browse and search the current repo's Forgejo or Gitea issues in a pane

plugins.name: work-session
plugins.description: Kick off and wrap up working sessions with your start and end commands, with a useful session title

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: A checklist pane for manual testing: Claude publishes the steps, you mark each one and send the results back

plugins.name: reading
plugins.description: A reading pane: Claude publishes documents, sections, issues and notes to read; you mark each read, acknowledged, agreed or to discuss, comment, and send the results back

plugins.name: worksheet
plugins.description: A pane over a JSON worksheet, with a tab per worksheet found: your priority and comment per row beside Claude's proposal, written straight back to the file

plugins.name: progress
plugins.description: A progress band above the prompt: the active plan's slice, the last honest check or build gate, the forge review queue, and tallies of a decision worksheet and a specification catalogue
